description:
Company: 
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. 
 Job Area: 
Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Video Systems, HW Architecture 
 General Summary: 
 Qualcomm’s Computer Vision Systems team is building the intelligence behind the world’s most advanced Snapdragon‑powered devices, from next‑gen mobile phones to autonomous vehicles, IoT, and immersive AR/VR platforms. The group’s work spans across computer vision algorithm development, CV accelerator architecture, and on‑device prototyping. If you’re passionate about shaping the future of on‑device vision processing, this is where your work will reach billions of users. 
 
 We’re looking for a Computer Vision Systems Engineer who thrives at the intersection of algorithms, hardware, and real‑world productization. You’ll help define and deliver the Snapdragon Vision API based features, enabling developers and OEMs to build breakthrough CV experiences on cutting‑edge hardware. Experience with CV hardware accelerators and OpenCV is a plus.  

 Key Responsibilities   

 Lead the design and implementation of computer vision features and on-device prototyping using the Snapdragon Vision API solution.  
 Support engineering teams in building, integrating, and deploying CV APIs for commercial products.  
 Develop clear and thorough technical documentation, diagrams, and sample materials that showcase the capabilities of the Snapdragon Vision API for end‑application developers.  
 Ensure deliverables meet schedule expectations and KPI targets, proactively identifying and addressing risks.  
 Collaborate closely with system, software, hardware, and product teams throughout CV feature prototyping and commercialization.  
 Contribute effectively in a fast‑paced, highly collaborative environment with distributed cross‑functional teams.  
 
 Minimum Qualifications: 
• Bachelor's degree in Computer or Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field and 4+ years of Software Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience. 
 OR
Master's degree in Computer or Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field and 3+ years of Software Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience. 
 OR
PhD in Computer or Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience. 
 
 
Required Skills
 
 Strong understanding of CV concepts, algorithms, and deep‑learning‑based vision pipelines, with a track record of delivering commercial CV solutions.  
 3–5 years of hands-on experience developing computer vision applications or libraries.  
 Proficiency in designing and implementing products using vision APIs, following established standards and best practices.  
 Strong coding and debugging skills in C/C++ and Python, with the ability to rapidly prototype and evaluate CV features on device.  
 
 
 Preferred Skills 

 Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.  
 Experience with CV and ML libraries such as OpenCV, TensorFlow, and PyTorch (TorchVision), including image processing and deep learning workflows.  
 Working knowledge of embedded systems and architectures, especially hardware CV accelerators.  
 Experience producing high‑quality API documentation and technical materials.  
 Familiarity with commercial software development practices and SDLC methodologies.

 Pay range and Other Compensation & Benefits : 
$155,400.00 - $233,200.00 
 The above pay scale reflects the broad, minimum to maximum, pay scale for this job code for the location for which it has been posted. Even more importantly, please note that salary is only one component of total compensation at Qualcomm.  We also offer a competitive annual discretionary bonus program and opportunity for annual RSU grants (employees on sales-incentive plans are not eligible for our annual bonus).  In addition, our highly competitive benefits package is designed to support your success at work, at home, and at play. Your recruiter will be happy to discuss all that Qualcomm has to offer – and you can review more details about our US benefits at this  link . 
 
 
 If you would like more information about this role, please contact Qualcomm Careers .
